title: protium heptaphyllum

It is a tree that is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America, and has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Protium heptaphyllum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and promoting overall health.
